derivation: Original bounded implementation. Format structure walkers are Turen-written parse-only code; EXIF/TIFF tag parsing delegates to the pinned kamadak-exif crate and bounded pixel decode to the pinned image crate (PNG/JPEG features only). No upstream CLI, filesystem, network, or extraction APIs are exposed.
decompressionBounds: zTXt/iTXt metadata inflate capped at 262144 bytes; pixel decode capped at 4096x4096 dimensions checked from the header before allocation
